title: Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer Brings Steve Rogers Home — and Doctor Doom Wants It All Back
excerpt: Marvel released the final Avengers: Doomsday trailer Monday, bringing back Chris Evans as Steve Rogers — now a father — and Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. The film opens December 18.
content:
Marvel Studios released the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday on Monday, November 23, and it answers the question fans have been asking since Chris Evans was first revealed to be returning: why is Steve Rogers back?

The three-minute trailer opens not with a battle but with a family. Steve Rogers (Evans) and Peggy Carter (Hayley Atwell) are living the quiet life Steve chose at the end of 2019's Avengers: Endgame — moved into a home together and raising a son, played by Wesley Holloway. Steve and Peggy talk about whether to tell the boy his father was Captain America, and the now-teenage son walks in and asks, "Dad, were you a superhero?" Then a bright flash of light interrupts everything, and the Fantastic Four appear at their home.

The Fantastic Four — Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Ebon Moss-Bachrach and Joseph Quinn — arrive to pull Steve back into the fight. Steve has to explain the Avengers to his own son: "There were six of us." And then comes the turn the whole trailer is built around. Doctor Doom, played by Robert Downey Jr. in his return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in a completely different role from Tony Stark, delivers the film's thesis: "All of you have lived stolen lives. But now you must give them back."

Three teams, one extinction-level threat

Marvel says the film assembles the Avengers, the X-Men and the Fantastic Four on screen together for the first time in Marvel's cinematic history, with heroes from three different Earths forced to band together or risk extinction. The trailer ends with the X-Men, the Avengers, the Fantastic Four and Thor charging into battle against Doom and an army of Sentinels — after showing the X-Men fighting the Avengers themselves, including Cyclops (James Marsden) going head to head with Sam Wilson's Captain America (Anthony Mackie). Marsden's Cyclops delivers the line X-Men fans have waited decades to hear in live action: "To me, my X-Men!"

Marvel also confirmed on Sunday that Hailee Steinfeld will reprise her role as Kate Bishop in the film. The returning cast includes Chris Hemsworth as Thor, Paul Rudd as Scott Lang, Simu Liu as Shang-Chi and Sebastian Stan as Bucky Barnes. The trailer also offers a first extended look at Doom's followers, the mysterious Latverian witches, though Marvel has not revealed their identities.

What it means

Analysis: this is the first Avengers film since Endgame in 2019, and the trailer's choice to lead with a family instead of a fight is the tell. Marvel is betting the biggest movie of the year on the emotional cost of the life Steve Rogers chose — and on Doom collecting on it. With less than a month to go before the December 18 opening, the question is no longer whether audiences will show up. It is whether the film can pay off seven years of waiting in a single night.
